text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

An all-female panel choosing a woman is weak evidence on its own. Panels are often drawn from whoever holds senior roles, and same-sex panels regularly hire both men and women. For a head-of-group role, client relationships, leadership and business development often count as much as years of design work, so eight years versus fifteen doesn't show she was less qualified.

Raising the panel's composition now would likely come across as an accusation without evidence and could harm your reputation in a small industry.

Instead, follow up politely on the written feedback request, citing any right to it in your jurisdiction. If the reasons are vague, inconsistent or contradicted by evidence, or if you learn of a pattern, consult an employment lawyer about your options and time limits.
